The Idea · Why Saudi, Why 2027

Saudi Arabia is not only building projects. It is shaping a new standard of living.

Saudi Alive 2027 brings the five sectors that define quality of life into one focused platform for decision-makers, investors, brands and institutions — timed for a market moving from ambition to execution.

Partnership Tiers Built for Visibility.

Partnership tiers designed around visibility, influence and access — built to deliver commercial impact, executive access and year-round brand credibility.

Platinum

الراعي الرئيسي

Own the highest-profile position: title association, opening-stage presence, VIP hosting, premium visibility and direct access to hosted buyers and media.

راعي القطاع
